title: Travel Support Program & Student/Non-Profit Discounts
description: Archived Vancouver 2015 Summit announcement about contributor travel support and student, government and non-profit registration discounts.
body:
If you are a key contributor to OpenStack and your company does not cover the costs of your travel or accommodation to be able to attend the Summit in Vancouver then we encourage you to apply for the Travel Support Program. Hurry, February 26, 2015 is the deadline. Apply HERE. 

If you are currently a university student, government or non-profit employee you may apply for discounted registration to the Summit. Apply here before April 3, 2014.
seoTitle: OpenStack Vancouver 2015 — Travel Support Program & Student/Non-Profit Discounts
archiveNotice: Archived event content. Dates, registration information and policies below apply to this historical Summit.
